parameter.name: mask_mode
input_constraints: the block mask contains both filled and empty logical cells
the dense palette contains only nonzero values
the mask and palette use the same logical coordinates
invariant_reasoning: identify the uniquely most-common shape colour
recover the large block mask and dense palette
map corresponding mask and palette coordinates
copy selected palette cells and write zero elsewhere

filled.text:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((shape-color (mode g 0))
                  (shape-cells (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))
                                   #:when
                                   (= (at g r c) shape-color))
                                 (list r c)))
                  (srs (map first shape-cells))
                  (scs (map second shape-cells))
                  (sr1 (min-list srs))
                  (sc1 (min-list scs))
                  (sr2 (max-list srs))
                  (sc2 (max-list scs))
                  (pal-cells (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))
                                 #:when
                                 (and (!= (at g r c) 0) (!= (at g r c) shape-color)))
                               (list r c)))
                  (prs (map first pal-cells))
                  (pcs (map second pal-cells))
                  (pr1 (min-list prs))
                  (pc1 (min-list pcs))
                  (pr2 (max-list prs))
                  (pc2 (max-list pcs))
                  (ph (+ 1 (- pr2 pr1)))
                  (pw (+ 1 (- pc2 pc1)))
                  (shape-h (+ 1 (- sr2 sr1)))
                  (shape-w (+ 1 (- sc2 sc1)))
                  (block-h (quotient shape-h ph))
                  (block-w (quotient shape-w pw)))
             (build-grid ph
                         pw
                         (br bc)
                         (let* ((br-pos (+ sr1 (* br block-h)))
                                (bc-pos (+ sc1 (* bc block-w)))
                                (filled (= (at g br-pos bc-pos) shape-color)))
                           (if filled (at g (+ pr1 br) (+ pc1 bc)) 0)))))))

limitations: This is a task-local prototype, not a selected or approved production rule.
Evidence covers two settings and one four-pair episode per setting, not every seed.
The input sampler is the fixed canonical generator; only the executed rule varies.
The hidden parameter is identifiable only when demonstrations include mixed masks, which this sampler enforces.
